en: Color photograph of a city street with a mountain backdrop. On the left is a long 19th‑century style building with arched windows and balconies; on the right stands a modern, elevated glass-and-concrete office or civic building. Cars and a bus from the 1960s–1970s are visible on the street and crosswalk, with trees lining the road and mountains rising steeply behind the town under a blue sky with scattered clouds.
